about: Vendors that are one maker under two names. A judgement, never a derivation: bin/mint-vendors.js folds spellings the characters agree about, and this is where a person says the rest. Read by that script; see data/curation/README.md.

merges.name: danja
merges.why: The same person. 'danja' is the handle on the plugins themselves and on the repositories they come from; 'Danny Ayers' is the same author spelled formally in a second source. Nothing in the two strings implies the other, which is why it is asserted here rather than derived.
